---
title: "DIF analysis"
author: "ASD CDI team"
date: '2026-11-05'
output: html_document
params:
  tier_A_only: false   # sensitivity check: only collections with trust tier A
  exclude_dx_unconfirmed: false  # sensitivity check: drop collections without confirmed ASD dx (2024, 9)
  include_flagged: false  # include collections that fail the item-profile check (WS 2024)
  refit: false         # refit IRT models even if a cached fit exists
---

```{r setup, message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(mirt)
library(gamlss)
source("helper_functions/DIF_helpers.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = F, warning = F)

load("data/nda_private/cached_data.Rds") # from 01_prep_data.Rmd

# IRT assumes independent respondents, so use one administration per ASD child
# (chosen at random in 01_prep_data.Rmd; NDAR includes longitudinal data).
asd_keep <- function(d) {
  d <- d %>% filter(one_per_child)
  if (params$tier_A_only) d <- d %>% filter(tier == "A")
  if (params$exclude_dx_unconfirmed) d <- d %>% filter(!asd_dx_unconfirmed)
  if (!params$include_flagged) d <- d %>% filter(item_profile_ok)
  d
}
suffix <- paste0(if (params$tier_A_only) "_tierA" else "",
                 if (params$exclude_dx_unconfirmed) "_dxconfirmed" else "",
                 if (params$include_flagged) "_withflagged" else "")
model_path <- function(form) sprintf("data/nda_private/prod%s_IRT_model%s.Rds", form, suffix)

# Build TD + ASD response matrix (same item order), dropping children who produce 0 words
build_dif_data <- function(td, asd) {
  items <- sort(unique(td$definition))
  stopifnot(setequal(items, unique(asd$definition)))
  td_mat <- td %>% transmute(sid = paste0("td_", data_id), definition, value = produces) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = sid, names_from = definition, values_from = value)
  asd_mat <- asd %>% transmute(sid = paste0("asd_", id), definition, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = sid, names_from = definition, values_from = value)
  mat <- bind_rows(td_mat, asd_mat)
  demo <- tibble(sid = mat$sid, group = ifelse(startsWith(mat$sid, "td_"), "TD", "ASD"),
                 production = rowSums(select(mat, all_of(items)), na.rm = T))
  keep <- demo$production > 0
  m <- data.matrix(mat[keep, items]); rownames(m) <- mat$sid[keep]
  list(mat = m, group = demo$group[keep], removed = count(demo[!keep, ], group))
}

fit_or_load <- function(dd, path) {
  if (params$refit || !file.exists(path)) {
    mod_dev_group <- fit_mod_intuitive(dd$mat, dd$group)
    save(mod_dev_group, file = path)
  }
  load(path)
  mod_dev_group
}

# Production percentiles by age (GAMLSS, beta family)
centile_plot <- function(demo_td, demo_asd, n_items, td_ages, asd_ages) {
  prep <- function(d) d %>% mutate(prop_produced = pmin(pmax(production / n_items, 0.001), 0.999))
  fit <- function(d) gamlss(prop_produced ~ pbm(age, lambda = 10000),
                            sigma.formula = ~ pbm(age, lambda = 10000),
                            family = BE, data = d, trace = F)
  # gamlss re-reads the fitting data by name when predicting, so pass it explicitly
  cents <- function(d, ages) centiles.pred(fit(d), cent = c(90, 75, 50, 25, 10),
                                           xname = "age", xvalues = ages, data = d, plot = F) %>%
    tibble() %>% pivot_longer(2:6, names_to = "percentile", values_to = "pred") %>% rename(age = x)
  demo_td <- prep(demo_td); demo_asd <- prep(demo_asd)
  ct <- cents(demo_td, td_ages); ca <- cents(demo_asd, asd_ages)
  p <- function(d, cc, title) ggplot(d, aes(x = jitter(age))) +
    geom_point(alpha = .1, aes(y = production)) +
    geom_line(data = cc, aes(x = age, y = pred * n_items, linetype = percentile)) +
    theme_classic() + xlab("Age (months)") + ylab("Production Sumscore") + ggtitle(title)
  ggpubr::ggarrange(p(demo_td, ct, "Typically-Developing"), p(demo_asd, ca, "ASD"),
                    ncol = 2, common.legend = T)
}
```

`r if (params$tier_A_only) "**Sensitivity analysis: tier-A collections only.**"`
`r if (params$exclude_dx_unconfirmed) "**Sensitivity analysis: collections without confirmed ASD diagnosis excluded.**"`
`r if (params$include_flagged) "**Sensitivity analysis: includes collections that fail the item-profile check (see 01_prep_data).**" else "Collections that fail the item-profile check in 01_prep_data (WS 2024) are excluded."`

# CDI:WS Production

```{r ws-data}
wb_items <- d_td_ws %>% distinct(category, definition)
asd_ws <- asd_keep(d_asd_ws)
dd_ws <- build_dif_data(d_td_ws, asd_ws)
```

The ASD sample has `r n_distinct(asd_ws$GUID)` children from `r n_distinct(asd_ws$collection_id)` collections, one administration per child.
Children producing no words were removed: `r paste(dd_ws$removed$n, dd_ws$removed$group, collapse = ", ")`.

```{r ws-centiles, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Production sumscores on the CDI:WS for TD vs. ASD children."}
demo_td_ws <- d_td_ws %>% distinct(data_id, age, production)
demo_asd_ws <- asd_ws %>% group_by(id, age) %>% summarise(production = sum(value, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop")
centile_plot(demo_td_ws, demo_asd_ws, 680, 16:30, 12:48)
```

```{r fit-ws-model}
mod_ws <- fit_or_load(dd_ws, model_path("WS"))

mm_asd <- extract_group_df(mod_ws, groups = c("TD", "ASD"))
mm_asd <- flag_dif(mm_asd)
thresh <- 2 * sd(mm_asd$d_diff)
big_dif <- mm_asd %>% filter(extreme)

print(item_difficulty_difference_histogram(mm_asd, withNormal = T))
save(mm_asd, file = sprintf("data/nda_private/dif_items_WS%s.Rds", suffix))
```

`d` is an easiness intercept, so d_ASD − d_TD < 0 means an item is harder for children with ASD than for TD children of the same overall vocabulary level.
Each group's latent mean is fixed at 0, so the overall gap between the samples appears as a uniform shift in d_ASD − d_TD (here `r round(mean(mm_asd$d_diff), 2)`).
We remove that shift and flag items more than 2 SD from it (|centered difference| > `r round(thresh,2)`; red dotted lines in the histogram).
There are `r nrow(big_dif)` such items:

```{r}
big_dif <- big_dif %>% left_join(wb_items, by = "definition")

big_dif %>% arrange(d_diff_c) %>%
  relocate(category, definition) %>%
  rename(d_TD = d_g1, d_ASD = d_g2, centered_diff = d_diff_c) %>%
  dplyr::select(category, definition, d_TD, d_ASD, d_diff, centered_diff) %>%
  kable(format = "html", table.attr = "style='width:50%;'", digits = 2)

sort(table(big_dif$category)) %>% kable(col.names = c("Category", "Frequency"))
```


# CDI:WG Production

```{r wg-data}
base::load("data/eng_wg_raw_data.Rds")

d_td_wg <- eng_wg %>%
  mutate(produces = value == "produces") %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  dplyr::select(data_id, produces, age, production, category, definition)

wg_items <- d_td_wg %>% distinct(category, definition)
asd_wg <- asd_keep(d_asd_wg)
dd_wg <- build_dif_data(d_td_wg, asd_wg)
```

The ASD sample has `r n_distinct(asd_wg$GUID)` children from `r n_distinct(asd_wg$collection_id)` collections, one administration per child.
Children producing no words were removed: `r paste(dd_wg$removed$n, dd_wg$removed$group, collapse = ", ")`.

```{r wg-centiles, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Production sumscores on the CDI:WG for TD vs. ASD children."}
demo_td_wg <- d_td_wg %>% distinct(data_id, age, production)
demo_asd_wg <- asd_wg %>% group_by(id, age) %>% summarise(production = sum(value, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop")
centile_plot(demo_td_wg, demo_asd_wg, 396, 8:18, 8:36)
```

```{r fit-wg-model}
mod_wg <- fit_or_load(dd_wg, model_path("WG"))

mm_asd_wg <- extract_group_df(mod_wg, groups = c("TD", "ASD"))
mm_asd_wg <- flag_dif(mm_asd_wg)
thresh_wg <- 2 * sd(mm_asd_wg$d_diff)
big_dif_wg <- mm_asd_wg %>% filter(extreme)

print(item_difficulty_difference_histogram(mm_asd_wg, withNormal = T))
save(mm_asd_wg, file = sprintf("data/nda_private/dif_items_WG%s.Rds", suffix))
```

`d` is an easiness intercept, so d_ASD − d_TD < 0 means an item is harder for children with ASD than for TD children of the same overall vocabulary level.
Each group's latent mean is fixed at 0, so the overall gap between the samples appears as a uniform shift in d_ASD − d_TD (here `r round(mean(mm_asd_wg$d_diff), 2)`).
We remove that shift and flag items more than 2 SD from it (|centered difference| > `r round(thresh_wg,2)`; red dotted lines in the histogram).
There are `r nrow(big_dif_wg)` such items:

```{r}
big_dif_wg <- big_dif_wg %>% left_join(wg_items, by = "definition")

big_dif_wg %>% arrange(d_diff_c) %>%
  relocate(category, definition) %>%
  rename(d_TD = d_g1, d_ASD = d_g2, centered_diff = d_diff_c) %>%
  dplyr::select(category, definition, d_TD, d_ASD, d_diff, centered_diff) %>%
  kable(format = "html", table.attr = "style='width:50%;'", digits = 2)

sort(table(big_dif_wg$category)) %>% kable(col.names = c("Category", "Frequency"))
```
